mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and thus positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in non-recession periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively affects consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 3-month average increase of 0.5%, indicating heightened inflation concerns, investors anticipate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL above the 3-month avg threshold, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when PAYEMS decreases by > 100k in a month and UNRATE rises above 5%, signaling labor market distress, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively affected over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating strengthened retail sales, positively affects business revenue expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns during holiday seasons are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
